'''Feral Parasites''' are a tier of [[Mobs|Parasites]] consisting of evolved, refined forms of [[Assimilated Mobs]]. In the hierarchy, they are above Assimilated Mobs, but roughly at or below [[Primitive Parasites]].

== Spawning ==
*Created when a [[Gnat]] or [[Lice]] is responsible for the mob's death (assuming the mob is not immune to COTH).
*Spawns naturally from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 8|Phase 8]] once enough of their Sane counterpart has been assimilated.
*Spawned by mobs succumbing to [[Call Of The Hive]] from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 7|Phase 7]] and onwards.
*Spawned when an [[Assimilated Mobs|Assimilated Mob]] accumulates a killcount of 60.

== Features ==
*Feral Parasites' melee attacks will inflict Call Of The Hive I.
*Feral Parasites are capable of performing small leaps in liquids.
*Feral Parasites are capable of pouncing in order to reach their targets.

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
Like all Parasites, Ferals present a weakness to fire (damage inflicted by fire is quadrupled).

== ''Survival Guides'' ==
These guys are stronger versions of their respective [[:Category:Assimilated Mobs|Assimilated versions]]

-Destroy all Vermins and Gnats in the area

-Pour lava, use fire

== ''Trivia'' ==
*The sounds of Feral Parasites are the sounds of their respective [[:Category:Assimilated Mobs|Assimilated versions]] put through an in-game audio filter.
*All current Feral Parasites have a set of small appendages coming from their mouths.
